text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Haa... Why did even I have to come along?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Because today was a day off, and I wanted to go on a three-sister date♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's worked suuuper hard up till today!
Let's make this a lovey-dovey, super-sweet outing!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, then I'll just have to pamper both of you.
Cheval, feel free to spoil yourself too, don't hold back♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I said I'm fine without that kind of thing...!

And so, together with her beloved big sisters,
Vivlos thoroughly enjoyed her day off.
